ui.filter: Table-owned fixed overlay; viewport resize/move only determines placement. Horizontal and vertical scrolling cannot move it with contents. No timer.
ui.hidden_networks: Scan SSID length and raw empty/NUL marker produce ssid_hidden. Literal hidden and __hidden__ names are not used as hidden-network evidence.
ui.results_window: Compact top clear/refresh actions; same QTabWidget/openwrtCaptureTabs theme as automatic capture; two mutually exclusive record types; scroll-driven background batches of 100, no visible paging controls.
ui.records: Names, MAC, result and per-dictionary confirmed/total counts. Unknown attempts are not counted as complete. Old missing dictionary totals show ?.
ui.copy: Final-password cell copies the exact value; secrets are released on page changes and close.
ui.clear: Clears both attempted and successful catalog records and password row status, preserving exported files. Hashed file signatures suppress automatic reimport of cleared exports. Fresh successful attempts can be recorded again. Transactional rollback and cancellation covered.

password_history_fix.cause: Successful passwords were incorrectly marked in the same skip table as confirmed wrong passwords.
password_history_fix.change: Only confirmed wrong passwords are skipped; successful credentials remain in result files and are eligible for verification again. Legacy successful fingerprints with matching saved result identity are removed from skip records.
password_history_fix.same_name_safety: Password result filenames include BSSID to avoid overwriting another AP with the same SSID.
password_history_fix.privacy: No plaintext passwords in SQLite, snapshots or diagnostic logs. Catalog fields and clipboard behavior are explicitly requested UI features.

initialization.observed_regression: The 150133 archive records 30.016s pipe readiness wait plus 30s PTY readiness wait before fallback. The extra readiness phase was withdrawn.
initialization.source_verified_issue: Initialization performed a normal netifd reload, then ifup. Exact official ifup scripts for all 50 supported releases first reload again, then force down/up.
initialization.root_cause_assessment: The duplicate restart disrupts the newly created temporary STA and can remove its supplicant control socket. The device uses the matching official ifup/mac80211/ucode lifecycle; its hostapd.sh differs only at an unrelated ANQP separator, while the control socket teardown matches official code. This supports removing the redundant ifup. Post-fix authentication startup on this router is still pending.
initialization.change: One standard network reload only; removed the subsequent ifup and its extra 3-second delay. Existing 5-second post-reload settling and per-request handshake timeout remain. Preparation and capability fallback reasons now appear in progress/messages.
initialization.live_actions: Strictly matched saved device fingerprint; read-only runtime, socket, lifecycle log and script hash queries. No wireless config changes, authentication candidates or daemon restarts performed by the diagnostics.

windows_final_integration.skip: POSIX shell execution absent on Windows; exact generated guard command passed separately under Debian /bin/sh.

validation.debian_desktop_gui: not verified; no claim of full desktop acceptance
validation.debian_environment_suite: Full module import blocked by missing PySide6. No dependencies installed. Native CLI contracts and isolated generated POSIX guard did run successfully.
